title: Physical-Variable-Informed Deep Learning for Robust Diagnosis in Industrial Fluid Transport Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.27891v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial fluid transport systems are monitored through heterogeneous sensing streams, but robust fault diagnosis remains difficult because response signals vary with operating conditions and differ from physical variables in sampling rate, observation duration and data granularity. To address these challenges, we propose a physical-variable-informed deep learning framework (PhyNet) for robust fault diagnosis under real-world sampling heterogeneity. PhyNet treats physical variables as global operating constraints and response signals as local diagnostic evidence. Its physical-to-response cross-attention mechanism connects sequence-level physical-variable tokens with a learnable global response token, enabling interaction without strict temporal alignment. Across four benchmarks, including three real-world cavitation datasets and one public two-phase-flow dataset, PhyNet achieves the best performance across all evaluated metrics. Class

translated_title: 物理变量信息驱动的深度学习用于工业流体输送系统的鲁棒故障诊断
translated_abstract: 工业流体输送系统通过异构的传感数据流进行监测，但由于响应信号会随运行工况变化，且在采样率、观测时长和数据粒度方面与物理变量存在差异，实现鲁棒的故障诊断仍然十分困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种物理变量信息驱动的深度学习框架，用于在真实世界的采样异构性条件下实现鲁棒故障诊断。PhyNet将物理变量视为全局运行约束，将响应信号视为局部诊断证据。其物理变量到响应信号的交叉注意力机制将序列级的物理变量标记与可学习的全局响应标记相连接，从而在无需严格时间对齐的情况下实现二者交互。在四个基准测试上，包括三个真实世界的空化数据集和一个公开的两相流数据集，PhyNet在所有评估指标上均取得了最佳性能。
tldr: 提出物理变量信息驱动的深度学习框架PhyNet，通过物理变量与响应信号之间的交叉注意力机制，在无需严格时间对齐的情况下，实现了工业流体输送系统在真实采样异构条件下的鲁棒故障诊断。
en_tdlr: PhyNet, a physical-variable-informed deep learning framework, employs a physical-to-response cross-attention mechanism to achieve robust fault diagnosis in industrial fluid transport systems under real-world sampling heterogeneity without requiring strict temporal alignment.
